name: Betaflight Configurator
description: App has no self-updater, but firmware-flash channel does no signature check before DFU flash.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Betaflight Configurator’s firmware workflow checks programmed data by comparing read-back bytes with the input. This is a firmware transfer-integrity observation, not independent publisher authentication or a primary-application update classification.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than the original study checkout; this review did not establish the source and verification policy of remote firmware providers or the application's separate update behavior.
